what: On a contrast stage-color (black) panel, the logo strip unfurls from the right end to the left via clip-path (1.6s cubic-bezier(.44,.05,.55,.94) after 1.2s), and with the same curve and length a round window rolls from the strip’s right end to its left end. At 3.6s the panel background flips from stage color → background color and the strip from stage text color → text color in one go with .6s ease-out, becoming a black symbol on a light panel. Below 900px width it runs 1.2s after 1.1s and flips at 3.3s

options.delay·dur·flip: Unfold delay, unfold length, flip start (sec), default 1.2·1.6·3.6
options.flip-dur: Flip duration (s), default .6 — 0 means no flip (flip at 0 means the same)
options.on: If “event,” it does not play as soon as it attaches but when fx:play reaches the element (when the loader lifts)
options.[data-fx-part=band]: Unfolding strip (SVG · logo) — colored with currentColor (fill: currentColor)
options.[data-fx-part=roller]: (If present) round window placed at the right end of the strip — rolls left by the strip width

use: …
note: When finished, sends fx:done to the element. With reduce, the band is unfurled, the circle sits at the left end, and it stands directly in the flipped end state

from.where: index.html .ik-fv (Hero — original main.bundle hero choreography: starts as the loader lifts, the symbol strip clip unfolds and the circular GIF window rolls in 1.2s later over 1.6s cubic-bezier(.44,.05,.55,.94), at 3.6s the background and strip colors flip over .6s ease-out, phone 1.1s·1.2s·3.3s)
